newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan realtor Kaneichi files for liquidation - Kyodo.
newsitem.headline: Japan realtor Kaneichi files for liquidation - Kyodo.

text.p: Japanese property firm Kaneichi has filed for court liquidation with debts of more than 90 billion yen, Kyodo news agency reported on Wednesday.
The Osaka-based property firm had borrowed a large amount of money from failed mortgage firms, the news agency said.
A spokesman for Kaneichi was not immediately available for comment.
Kyodo said Kaneichi had filed for special liquidation at the Osaka District Court.
Firms apply for special liquidation when they are insolvent and in the process of being wound up, lawyers said.
Private research companies have estimated Kaneichi's debts at between 75 billion yen and 90 billion yen.
One research firm said that Kaneichi's debts totalled about 90 billion yen in its business year to August 1995, but it may have moved some of its debts to subsidiaries.
